body: AI Agents & MCPs & AI Workflow Automation • (~400 MCP servers for AI agents) • AI Automation / AI Agent with MCPs • AI Workflows & AI Agents • MCPs for AI Agents
plain_description: **Automate business tasks by connecting apps and building AI powered workflows.** Use a visual builder to create flows with hundreds of integrations. Self-host the platform and customize integrations with TypeScript.
technical_description: Activepieces is an open source workflow automation platform with a visual flow builder, AI features, and a TypeScript framework for creating integrations called pieces. The README says pieces can be used as MCP servers with LLMs such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf. It supports self-hosted deployment and network-gapped operation.
title: Activepieces

body: aider is AI pair programming in your terminal
plain_description: **Help your team build and update software with an AI coding partner in the terminal.** Aider can work on new or existing codebases, apply changes, and automatically commit them. It also runs linters and tests after edits.
technical_description: Aider is a terminal-based AI pair programmer that connects to cloud or local LLMs. It maps a codebase, supports more than 100 programming languages, integrates with Git, and can make and commit code changes. Users can also work through an IDE or editor, provide images and web pages as context, use voice input, and run linting and tests after changes.
title: Aider

body: Official implementation of AnimateDiff.
plain_description: **Turn text-to-image models into animation generators without additional training.** Create animations with community models, or guide them using motion controls, images, and sketches. A Gradio demo is included.
technical_description: AnimateDiff is a plug-and-play module that adds motion to community text-to-image models in the Stable Diffusion family. The repository provides scripts for animation generation, MotionLoRA camera movement controls, and SparseCtrl conditioning from RGB images or sketches. It includes a Gradio demo and describes training domain adapters, motion modules, and optional MotionLoRA modules. The README notes that inference with the SDXL beta usually requires about 13 GB of VRAM, depending on the selected models and settings.
title: AnimateDiff

body: Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with AnythingLLM. Everything you need for a powerful local-first agent experience
plain_description: **Chat with your documents and automate workflows using AI agents in a private, configurable AI app.** Connect local or cloud AI models and start in minutes. Run it locally or support multiple users with controlled access.
technical_description: AnythingLLM is an all-in-one AI application for chatting with documents and building AI agent workflows. It supports local and cloud language models, document ingestion and pipelines, multiple users and permissions, vector databases, and a developer API. It offers desktop and Docker deployments, plus cloud deployment options.
title: AnythingLLM

body: Apache Spark - A unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing
plain_description: **Process large volumes of data and turn them into useful analysis.** Use Spark for SQL, machine learning, graph processing, and streaming workloads. Work through APIs in Scala, Java, Python, or R.
technical_description: Apache Spark is a unified analytics engine for large-scale data processing. It provides high-level APIs in Scala, Java, Python, and R, with tools for SQL and DataFrames, pandas workloads, machine learning, graph processing, and stream processing.
title: Apache Spark

body: AI Observability & Evaluation
plain_description: **See how your AI applications perform and find problems faster.** Trace activity, evaluate results, and compare experiments. Manage datasets and prompts as you improve your applications.
technical_description: Arize Phoenix is an open-source, self-hosted AI observability platform for experimenting with, evaluating, and troubleshooting AI applications. It supports OpenTelemetry-based tracing, LLM evaluations, versioned datasets and experiments, prompt management, and an interactive playground. It can run locally, in containers, Kubernetes, or the cloud, and provides REST and MCP interfaces.
title: Arize Phoenix

body: Audiocraft is a library for audio processing and generation with deep learning. It features the state-of-the-art EnCodec audio compressor / tokenizer, along with MusicGen, a simple and controllable music generation LM with textual and melodic conditioning.
plain_description: **Create high-quality music and sound from text prompts.** Control music generation with text or melodies. Explore audio generation and compression models for research and training.
technical_description: AudioCraft is a PyTorch library for audio-generation research, with inference and training code for AudioGen and MusicGen. It also includes EnCodec, Multi Band Diffusion, MAGNeT, AudioSeal, MusicGen Style, and JASCO. The README documents installation, model-specific workflows, training pipelines, and API documentation.
title: AudioCraft

body: A programming framework for agentic AI
plain_description: **Build multi-agent AI applications that can work autonomously or alongside people.** Use it to prototype agent workflows with code or AutoGen Studio’s no-code interface. The project is archived and no longer maintained; its maintainers advise against production use.
technical_description: AutoGen is a Python and .NET framework for creating multi-agent AI applications. It provides core message passing and runtimes, AgentChat APIs for common multi-agent patterns, and extensions for model clients and tools. AutoGen Studio offers a no-code interface for prototyping workflows. The repository is archived and no longer maintained.
title: AutoGen

body: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
plain_description: **Put a team of AI experts to work on content, sales, research, and recurring tasks.** Brief specialists in plain English and review their work. Otto coordinates the team and keeps you updated.
technical_description: AutoGPT provides a hosted platform and a self-hosted option for coordinating AI experts and building workflows. Users can choose or create specialists, connect apps, set instructions and spending controls, and review activity. Its visual builder connects blocks and controls workflow steps; workflows can also be run or built from code or an AI coding agent. Self-hosting uses Docker and requires model credentials and infrastructure management.
title: AutoGPT

body: Go ahead and axolotl questions
plain_description: **Fine-tune large language models for your business needs.** Use a shared configuration to prepare data, train, evaluate, and quantize models. Supports local hardware and cloud platforms.
technical_description: Axolotl is an open-source framework for post-training and fine-tuning large language models. It supports full fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, preference tuning, reinforcement learning, reward modeling, and quantization-aware training. A YAML configuration can cover dataset preprocessing, training, evaluation, quantization, and inference. It supports NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, distributed training, Docker, and cloud platforms.
title: Axolotl

body: The easiest way to serve AI apps and models - Build Model Inference APIs, Job queues, LLM apps, Multi-model pipelines, and more!
plain_description: **Turn AI models into services your business can run.** Build inference APIs and deploy models in Docker or Kubernetes. BentoML also helps manage dependencies and improve serving efficiency.
technical_description: BentoML is a Python library for building online serving systems for AI applications and model inference. It turns model inference code into REST API servers, packages code, models, and dependencies into deployable Bentos, and supports Docker and Kubernetes deployment. Serving features include dynamic batching, model parallelism, multi-stage pipelines, and multi-model inference graphs.
title: BentoML

body: sentence-similarity
plain_description: **Find and rank relevant information across languages and long documents.** Generate dense, sparse, or multi-vector text representations for search. Supports more than 100 languages and inputs up to 8,192 tokens.
technical_description: BGE-M3 is a multilingual embedding model supporting dense retrieval, sparse lexical matching, and multi-vector retrieval. It handles more than 100 languages and sequences up to 8,192 tokens. The README provides examples for generating embeddings and scoring text pairs, and describes fine-tuning options.
title: BGE-M3

body: Buzz transcribes and translates audio offline on your personal computer. Powered by OpenAI's Whisper.
plain_description: **Turn audio and video into searchable transcripts and translations on your computer.** Export captions in TXT, SRT, or VTT, or use live microphone transcription. Create summaries with plugins.
technical_description: Buzz is a desktop application for offline transcription and translation of audio and video, powered by OpenAI Whisper. It supports files, YouTube links, and live microphone transcription; speaker identification, speech separation, multiple Whisper backends, and NVIDIA CUDA, Apple Silicon, or Vulkan acceleration; transcript export to TXT, SRT, and VTT; a command-line interface; watch folders; and plugins including AI summaries.
title: Buzz

body: Minimalist ML framework for Rust
plain_description: **Build and run machine learning models in Rust with a lightweight framework focused on performance.** Use it to add model training and inference to applications. Examples cover language, vision, image generation, and speech models.
technical_description: Candle is a minimalist Rust machine learning framework with tensor operations, neural network tools, datasets, transformer utilities, and model examples. It supports optimized CPU execution, NVIDIA CUDA GPUs, Apple Accelerate, and WebAssembly. It can load safetensors, npz, ggml, and PyTorch files, and includes quantization support and ONNX model evaluation.
title: Candle

body: Powerful AI Client
plain_description: **Bring popular AI assistants into one app for everyday work.** Chat with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and local models, and create images with DALL·E 3. Desktop and mobile apps are available.
technical_description: Chatbox is a desktop client for ChatGPT, Claude, and other language models, with Windows, macOS, and Linux support, plus iOS, Android, and a web version. It supports providers including OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Ollama; features include local data storage, streaming replies, prompt libraries, team collaboration, and DALL·E 3 image generation.
title: Chatbox (Community Edition)

body: A generative speech model for daily dialogue.
plain_description: **Turn text into natural, expressive speech for dialogue.** Supports multiple speakers and control over pauses, laughter, and other speech details. Includes a web interface and command-line tools.
technical_description: ChatTTS is a text-to-speech model designed for dialogue scenarios, including LLM assistants. It supports English and Chinese, streaming audio generation, multiple speakers, and fine-grained prosody controls. The README shows Python installation and usage, a WebUI, and command-line inference. It states that the released model is for academic and research use.
title: ChatTTS

body: Search infrastructure for AI
plain_description: **Search your business’s documents and data by meaning, keywords, or both.** Chroma stores and indexes information so your applications can find relevant results quickly. Add documents with automatic or custom embeddings, then search and filter them.
technical_description: Chroma is open-source data infrastructure for AI, providing vector, hybrid, and full-text search. Its Python and JavaScript clients support creating collections, adding documents and metadata, and querying similar results. It can run in memory for prototyping, persist data locally, or be used in client-server mode; Chroma Cloud offers hosted serverless search.
title: Chroma

body: CodeGeeX: An Open Multilingual Code Generation Model (KDD 2023)
plain_description: **Help developers generate and translate code across multiple programming languages.** CodeGeeX also offers code completion, explanation, and summarization through IDE extensions.
technical_description: A 13-billion-parameter, transformer-based multilingual code generation model trained on code from more than 20 programming languages. It supports code generation and cross-language translation, with a VS Code and JetBrains programming assistant. The README describes inference on Ascend and NVIDIA GPUs, with PyTorch and MindSpore implementations, and provides quantized inference options.
title: CodeGeeX: A Multilingual Code Generation Model

body: text and image to video generation: CogVideoX (2024) and CogVideo (ICLR 2023)
plain_description: **Create videos from text prompts or still images.** Generate text-to-video, image-to-video, and video continuation clips. Fine-tuning options are also available.
technical_description: Open-source video generation models with inference and fine-tuning code. The repository supports SAT and Diffusers workflows, provides Gradio demos, and includes quantized inference options. Model versions vary in resolution, duration, memory use, and supported tasks; documented runs use NVIDIA GPUs.
title: CogVideo & CogVideoX

body: Debug, evaluate, and monitor your LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows with comprehensive tracing, automated evaluations, and production-ready dashboards.
plain_description: **Track and improve the quality of your AI applications and agents.** Opik helps teams review traces, evaluate outputs, and monitor applications in production. Self-host it in your own environment or use Comet’s cloud service.
technical_description: Opik is an open-source platform for LLM observability, evaluation, prompt management, and AI agent tracing. It captures traces through Python and TypeScript SDKs, OpenTelemetry, and framework integrations; supports datasets, experiments, LLM-as-a-judge metrics, and online evaluation; and provides dashboards for production monitoring. Deploy with Docker Compose or Kubernetes, or use Comet Cloud.
title: Opik

body: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
plain_description: **Create images, videos, audio, and 3D content with control over models, settings, and outputs.** Build and reuse visual workflows without code. Run locally or use cloud and production API options.
technical_description: ComfyUI is a modular AI creation engine with a visual node graph for building and reusing workflows. It supports image, video, audio, 3D, and text generation; runs locally on consumer hardware and supports quantized models, custom nodes, workflow JSON, and API endpoints.
title: ComfyUI

body: open-source coding agent
plain_description: **Help your developers work faster with an open-source coding agent.** Use it from the CLI, VS Code, or JetBrains.
technical_description: Continue is an open-source coding agent available as a CLI, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin. The README describes the 2.0.0 release and says the repository is read-only and no longer actively maintained. Anonymous telemetry was removed in the final release.
title: Continue

body: 🐸💬 - a deep learning toolkit for Text-to-Speech, battle-tested in research and production
plain_description: **Turn written content into natural sounding speech for multilingual products and services.** Use ready made models or train and fine tune models for your needs. Convert voices and curate speech datasets.
technical_description: A Python library for text to speech generation with pretrained models, training and fine tuning tools, dataset analysis utilities, and voice conversion. It includes command line and Python APIs, supports multi speaker and multilingual synthesis, and can run a server in Docker.
title: Coqui TTS

body: Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents. By fostering collaborative intelligence, CrewAI empowers agents to work together seamlessly, tackling complex tasks.
plain_description: **Coordinate AI agents to automate complex business workflows.** Assign agents specialized roles and tasks, then combine their work in event-driven processes. Connect tools, add human review, and keep control over how work runs.
technical_description: CrewAI is an open-source Python framework for building multi-agent workflows. Crews coordinate autonomous, role-based agents, while Flows provide event-driven execution with state, branching, and routing. The framework supports tools, memory, knowledge, checkpointing, async execution, MCP/A2A, and connections to hosted or local language models.
title: CrewAI

body: The premier open source Data Quality solution
plain_description: **Profile, correct, and enrich your business data with an open-source data quality toolkit.** Use it for one-time analysis or recurring data cleansing. It also supports data matching and master data management solutions.
technical_description: DataCleaner is a Java data quality toolkit for profiling, correcting, and enriching data. Its modules include an execution engine, built-in components and extensions, job and configuration file utilities, and a Swing-based desktop interface. The project is maintained for compatibility and security updates, while new features are driven by pull requests.
title: DataCleaner

body: DeepSeek Coder: Let the Code Write Itself
plain_description: **Help your team write, complete, and fill in code across many programming languages.** Choose from model sizes ranging from 1B to 33B. Fine-tune models for downstream tasks.
technical_description: DeepSeek Coder is a family of code language models trained on code and natural language. Models support project-level code completion and infilling, chat inference, and fine-tuning. The README demonstrates use with Transformers and vLLM, and describes converting models to GGUF or using GPTQ with ExLlamaV2.
title: DeepSeek Coder

body: text-generation
plain_description: **Use advanced AI reasoning to help tackle complex math, coding, and analysis tasks.** The model can be run locally or accessed through DeepSeek’s chat website and OpenAI-compatible API. Smaller distilled versions are also available.
technical_description: DeepSeek-R1 is a family of reasoning models trained with reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning. The repository includes the 671B-parameter DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-R1-Zero models, plus distilled 1.5B–70B Qwen- and Llama-based checkpoints. The README describes local serving of distilled models with vLLM or SGLang and an OpenAI-compatible API on DeepSeek Platform.
title: DeepSeek-R1

body: text-generation
plain_description: **Use DeepSeek-V3 to generate text, answer questions, and help with code and math.** Run it locally or use DeepSeek’s chat website and OpenAI-compatible API. It supports deployment on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs.
technical_description: DeepSeek-V3 is a 671B-parameter mixture-of-experts language model with 37B parameters activated per token. The README describes local inference through DeepSeek-Infer Demo, SGLang, LMDeploy, TensorRT-LLM, and vLLM, with FP8 and BF16 options across supported hardware. It also offers a chat website and an OpenAI-compatible API. The repository metadata identifies safetensors as the model format and lists a minimum RAM estimate of 1369 GB and recommended RAM of 2053.5 GB.
title: DeepSeek-V3

body: DeepSeek-VL2: Mixture-of-Experts Vision-Language Models for Advanced Multimodal Understanding
plain_description: **Analyze images and documents with AI that can answer visual questions and recognize text.** It can also understand tables, charts, and object locations in images.
technical_description: DeepSeek-VL2 is a Mixture-of-Experts vision-language model family with Tiny, Small, and full variants. It supports visual question answering, OCR, document/table/chart understanding, visual grounding, and conversations about one or more images. The README demonstrates local inference through Python and a Gradio web demo; it reports GPU memory needs of up to 80 GB or more for some variants, with incremental prefilling enabling VL2-Small on 40 GB.
title: DeepSeek-VL2

body: Code for the paper Hybrid Spectrogram and Waveform Source Separation
plain_description: **Separate a song into vocals, drums, bass, and accompaniment for remixing, karaoke, or audio editing.** Run it on audio files from the command line, or use the linked web demo or graphical interfaces.
technical_description: Demucs is a Python music source separation tool. Its v4 Hybrid Transformer Demucs model combines spectrogram and waveform processing to separate audio into stems; available models also support six sources, including guitar and piano. It runs on CPU or GPU, accepts formats supported by torchaudio, and can save separated tracks as WAV or MP3. The README also describes Python APIs and model training.
title: Demucs Music Source Separation

body: Diffusion Bee is the easiest way to run Stable Diffusion locally on your M1 Mac. Comes with a one-click installer. No dependencies or technical knowledge needed.
plain_description: **Create and edit AI images on a Mac with a simple desktop app.** Generate images from prompts, modify images, and upscale results. The app runs locally after model weights are downloaded.
technical_description: A macOS GUI for running Stable Diffusion locally on Intel and Apple Silicon Macs. It supports text-to-image and image-to-image generation, inpainting, outpainting, ControlNet, LoRA, image upscaling, and model downloads through the app. The README states that data stays on the computer unless the user uploads an image; downloading model weights requires a network request.
title: Diffusion Bee

body: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
plain_description: **Build and launch AI-powered workflows and apps from one collaborative workspace.** Create agents and RAG pipelines, then deploy on Dify Cloud or in your own environment.
technical_description: Dify is an open-source LLM app development platform with visual AI workflow building, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, model management, and application monitoring. It integrates with proprietary and open-source models, including OpenAI API-compatible models, and provides APIs for integrating Dify apps into business systems. The README documents Docker Compose self-hosting and hosted Dify Cloud.
title: Dify

body: docTR (Document Text Recognition) - a seamless, high-performing & accessible library for OCR-related tasks powered by Deep Learning. Ongoing development and maintenance by t2k.
plain_description: **Turn PDFs and images into usable, searchable text for your business.** Extract words and document layouts, including tables and other regions. A local demo and Docker images are available.
technical_description: docTR is a PyTorch-powered OCR library that processes PDFs and images in two stages: text detection and text recognition. It provides OCR and key information extraction predictors, optional document layout detection, and export to nested JSON. It can be used as a Python package, in a local Streamlit demo, in Docker, or through a documented FastAPI template.
title: docTR

body: The community repository for the Draw Things app.
plain_description: **Build and run image generation with Draw Things.** The repository provides code for the app’s image models, samplers, and training, plus tools to generate images locally or host a server.
technical_description: Community repository for public-facing code used by the Draw Things app. It includes implementations of image generation models, samplers, data models, and training, along with a local inference and LoRA training CLI and a self-hosted gRPC server CLI. The README documents building and running these tools on macOS and CUDA-capable Linux, including Docker deployment for the server.
title: Draw Things Community

body: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system
plain_description: **Run fast analytics directly inside your application, without managing a separate database server.** Read local or remote files and query data across connected databases. Use SQL through a standalone command line tool or language clients.
technical_description: DuckDB is an in-process analytical database designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect, reads and writes formats including CSV, Parquet, JSON, and Excel from local or remote sources, and can query connected PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and DuckDB databases. It is available as a standalone CLI and through multiple language clients, with a runtime extension mechanism.
title: DuckDB

body: 🦉 Data Versioning and ML Experiments
plain_description: **Keep data, models, and experiments organized and reproducible as your team develops machine learning projects.** Track changes alongside code in Git. Share data and models through cloud or on-premise storage.
technical_description: DVC is a command-line tool for versioning data and models, defining lightweight pipelines, tracking experiments locally in Git, and comparing data, code, parameters, metrics, and plots. It supports remote storage including cloud and on-premise options, and has a VS Code extension for experiment tracking and data management.
title: Data Version Control

body: feature-extraction
plain_description: **Turn text in many languages into embeddings for search and similarity matching.** Use the vectors to retrieve relevant passages or compare the meaning of text.
technical_description: A multilingual text embedding model with 24 layers and 1024-dimensional embeddings. Inputs are prefixed with “query: ” or “passage: ” depending on the task, tokenized to a maximum of 512 tokens, and mean pooled with attention masks before normalization. The model supports 100 languages; low-resource languages may see lower performance. Usage examples are provided for Transformers and Sentence Transformers.
title: Multilingual-E5-large

body: Ready-to-use OCR with 80+ supported languages and all popular writing scripts including Latin, Chinese, Arabic, Devanagari, Cyrillic and etc.
plain_description: **Extract text from images in more than 80 languages.** Use it to turn image text into readable text with confidence scores. Run it from Python or the command line, and choose CPU-only mode if needed.
technical_description: EasyOCR is a ready-to-use OCR library supporting more than 80 languages and common writing scripts. It detects text in images and returns bounding boxes, recognized text, and confidence scores. It supports Python and command-line use, can run in CPU-only mode, and can download model weights automatically or use manually downloaded weights.
title: EasyOCR

body: A fast inference library for running LLMs locally on modern consumer-class GPUs
plain_description: **Run large language models locally at high speed on consumer GPUs.** Generate text through a Python library or use a compatible server or web interface. Supports batch generation and custom model quantization.
technical_description: ExLlamaV2 is an inference library for running local LLMs on modern consumer GPUs. It provides Python APIs for single, batched, and streamed text generation, supports speculative decoding and GPTQ and EXL2 quantized models, and requires CUDA and PyTorch. The project is archived; its README points to TabbyAPI as the recommended backend server.
title: ExLlamaV2

body: A library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors.
plain_description: **Search large collections of vectors quickly to find the closest matches.** Supports exact and approximate search, with options to trade search speed and quality for memory use.
technical_description: Faiss is a C++ library with Python/NumPy wrappers for similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. It supports L2, dot-product, and cosine similarity; index structures including exact search, HNSW, and NSG; and compressed representations for scaling to billions of vectors in main memory. Optional GPU implementations support NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm, with single- and multi-GPU use.
title: Faiss

body: image-text-to-text
plain_description: **Understand and describe images with an AI model.** It can answer prompts about image content, including fine details and small objects.
technical_description: An 11B-parameter vision-language model built by TII by combining a pretrained CLIP ViT-L/14 vision encoder with a Falcon2 chat-finetuned model. It accepts image-and-text prompts and generates text using Transformers and PyTorch 2.0 or later. The README describes research use and provides an inference example.
title: Falcon2-11B-vlm

body: Faster Whisper transcription with CTranslate2
plain_description: **Turn audio into written transcripts faster, with less memory use.** Transcribe recordings on CPU or NVIDIA GPU, with optional 8-bit quantization to improve efficiency.
technical_description: A Python reimplementation of OpenAI Whisper using CTranslate2 for audio transcription. Supports CPU and NVIDIA GPU inference, batched transcription, word-level timestamps, voice activity detection, and 8-bit quantization. Whisper models can be converted to CTranslate2 format, including user fine-tuned models.
title: Faster Whisper transcription with CTranslate2

body: SOTA Open Source TTS
plain_description: **Create expressive, natural sounding speech from text for your business.** Clone voices from short audio samples and produce multilingual, multi-speaker dialogue. Edit generated speech and guide its emotion with natural-language instructions.
technical_description: Fish Speech is an open-source text-to-speech system offering the Drama 3 and S2-Pro voice models. It supports multilingual voice cloning, multi-speaker generation, natural-language control of emotion and prosody, and an API server and WebUI. Drama 3 adds long-form dialogue, local audio editing, and multi-turn revision. The README links installation and inference guides for command-line, API-server, WebUI, and Docker setup.
title: Fish Speech

body: image-text-to-text
plain_description: **Analyze images to create captions, detect and locate objects, and read text.** Use one model for a range of vision tasks by changing the prompt. It supports both zero-shot use and fine-tuning.
technical_description: Florence-2 is a prompt-based vision foundation model with a sequence-to-sequence architecture for vision and vision-language tasks. The README demonstrates inference with Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch, and lists image captioning, object detection, segmentation, region proposals, phrase grounding, and OCR tasks. The snapshot identifies safetensors and PyTorch formats and estimates 1.6 GB minimum and 2.4 GB recommended RAM.
title: Florence-2: Advancing a Unified Representation for a Variety of Vision Tasks

body: Build AI Agents, Visually
plain_description: **Build AI agents visually to automate business workflows.** Connect models, data sources, and tools in a visual flow. Deploy it on your own infrastructure or use Flowise Cloud.
technical_description: Flowise is a self-hostable visual platform for building AI agents and flows. Its repository describes a Node.js server, React frontend, and third-party integration components. It supports npm installation and Docker deployment, with deployment options for cloud providers. The README states that the project has been archived.
title: Flowise

body: Official inference repo for FLUX.1 models
plain_description: **Create and edit images with FLUX open-weight models.** Generate images from text or edit existing images, including inpainting and structural conditioning.
technical_description: Minimal Python inference code for running FLUX open-weight image generation and editing models. Supports local installation, optional TensorRT support, and usage tracking for commercial licensing. The README also describes an API that provides access to the models.
title: FLUX

body: Focus on prompting and generating
plain_description: **Create high quality images from prompts with minimal setup and tweaking.** Generate text to image art, variations, and upscales, or edit images with inpainting and outpainting. Runs offline after setup.
technical_description: Fooocus is an offline image generation application based on Stable Diffusion XL. It provides text-to-image generation, image variation and upscaling, inpainting and outpainting, image prompts, face swap, and image description through a Gradio interface. The project is in limited long-term support with bug fixes only. The README documents local Windows, Linux, and Mac setup, Docker, and Colab; minimum requirements include 4 GB Nvidia GPU memory and 8 GB system memory for supported configurations.
title: Fooocus

body: the LLM vulnerability scanner
plain_description: **Find weaknesses in LLM applications before they cause problems.** Scan for issues such as prompt injection, data leakage, hallucinations, and harmful outputs. Review reports showing which probes found vulnerabilities.
technical_description: garak is a command-line tool for red-teaming and assessing LLM-backed applications. It runs static, dynamic, and adaptive probes against a selected model, then uses detectors to identify undesirable behavior and reports results. The README lists support for Hugging Face, OpenAI, Replicate, AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM, REST endpoints, and GGUF models such as llama.cpp.
title: garak, LLM vulnerability scanner

body: Original reference implementation of "3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering"
plain_description: **Create detailed 3D scenes from photos or video and render new viewpoints in real time.** Train a scene model from COLMAP or synthetic NeRF data, then inspect it with interactive viewers.
technical_description: Official research implementation for 3D Gaussian Splatting. It trains a scene representation from COLMAP or synthetic NeRF datasets using a PyTorch optimizer and CUDA extensions, then renders novel views with an OpenGL viewer. Includes tools for dataset conversion, evaluation, and interactive inspection; training requires a CUDA-ready GPU.
title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering

body: image-text-to-text
plain_description: **Use Gemma 3 27B IT to work with image and text inputs.** The supplied sources do not describe specific business tasks or setup.
technical_description: Gemma 3 27B IT is identified as an image-text-to-text model. The repository metadata lists Transformers and the safetensors model format. The README is empty, so the supplied sources do not establish how to run it or what capabilities beyond its task label it supports.
title: Gemma 3 27B IT

body: GPT4All: Run Local LLMs on Any Device. Open-source and available for commercial use.
plain_description: **Run private AI conversations on everyday desktops and laptops.** Use the desktop app to chat with local language models and your own documents. No API calls or GPU are required.
